Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misidentification of Relationships and Sources. The Planner incorrectly assumed that the "younger brother" referred to a character relationship within the show (specifically Finn's adoptive brother Jake) rather than a real-world familial relationship between the actual guest stars (actors). The search results clearly identified Brian Doyle-Murray as a guest star, and the Planner failed to recognize that Brian Doyle-Murray is the father of Bill Murray, making Bill Murray his younger brother. Instead of searching for the real-world family connections of the actors, the Planner pursued a fictional character family tree, leading to the wrong conclusion that no younger brother exists among the guest stars.
